title.narrative: IDF for Building Capacity in the Procurement Audit Agency

description.narrative: The proposed IDF grant aims at improving the quality of governance and accountability in the implementation of all government and IFI-financed projects in Kazakhstan. Specifically, the grant will be used to: (i) conduct independent procurement evaluation of selected IFI-financed projects; (ii) build capacity within the Ministry of Finance (MoF) to evaluate the procurement activities of projects; and (iii) institutionalize mechanisms for impartial and efficient evaluation and verification of technical aspects of projects. The proposed IDF grant is closely linked to the Bank's dialogue with the Government in Kazakhstan on institutional capacity building and fiduciary risks. Strengthening fiduciary standards, especially with respect to its procurement procedures, is a key requirement for improved governance and anti-corruption. The Government of Kazakhstan already has a unit within MoF that performs project assessments reporting to the Office of the President of Kazakhstan. The grant will engage a reputable international firm specializing in procurement audits to: (i) undertake comprehensive procurement evaluation of selected IFI financed projects; (ii) provide necessary training for staff in the MoF unit responsible for project assessments; (iii) advise MOF on the institutionalization of independent procurement evaluation procedures; and (iv) identify vulnerable systemic procedures that should be addressed to improve governance and reduce corruption. Expected outcomes include: (i) improved transparency of procurement procedures; (ii) MoF staff equipped with necessary knowledge and skills; and (iii) weaknesses identified in the legal, legislative and institutional framework for procurement in Kazakhstan.
